historical_reviews.deepseek: Its IPMI data may be auxiliary, but it replaces the specified Redfish path, truncates fallback coverage and confuses DIMM with GPU sensors.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly retains automation while restoring the source interface and a complete DIMM-specific oracle.
historical_reviews.history: The same code at row 1869 is a distinct GPU-temperature Source Identity and must not supply sensor names, method or expected results to this row.
historical_reviews.v3_1: DIMM temperature coverage must be population-aware: each installed DIMM slot or vendor thermal zone needs a unique mapping, while unpopulated slots must be distinguished from missing telemetry. Zone sensors cannot be assumed to represent every DIMM without a vendor topology contract.

original_test_intent: Verify that all expected DIMM temperature resources for the installed memory topology are present, current, healthy and correctly mapped through the Redfish Sensors collection and member resources.
original_method: Discover the firmware-approved Sensors collection, enumerate every member, select DIMM temperature resources by structured identity, GET all mapped members, reconcile them with populated socket/channel/slot topology, validate reading units, health, thresholds and freshness, and preserve complete redacted JSON without changing thermal policy or logs.
manual_activity: No interactive action is required for a supported ordinary run; the package owner pre-validates the URI/schema, population-to-sensor map and range/freshness rules and reviews only missing, stale, unsupported or inconsistent telemetry.
required_inputs: Canonical Redfish Sensors URI and schema
Expected DIMM or zone sensor map
safety_requirements: Do not change fan or threshold policy
Do not change power or memory state
Use trusted TLS and secret-safe sessions
Enumerate every member without head/grep truncation
Do not treat unpopulated slots as missing sensors
Do not accept GPU sensor names for this identity
Fail closed on stale or ambiguous mappings
agent_execution_scope: Verify target, URI and memory population
GET and parse each mapped member
Validate slot/zone identity, units, health, thresholds and timestamp
engineer_actions: Review missing, stale or out-of-range sensors

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The ipmitool queries are read-only but do not execute the source Redfish collection/member method; the SDR fallback truncates results and the expected GPU sensor family is the wrong Source Identity.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use a protected structured Redfish client to GET the validated collection and every expected DIMM temperature member, preserving complete JSON and validating populated slot/zone identity, units, health, thresholds, freshness and range.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Redfish DIMM-temperature monitoring intent and 5/5-minute estimate remain; malformed URLs, log clearing, IPMI substitution and GPU evidence are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Produce a table joining each installed DIMM topology coordinate to its Redfish sensor or approved zone, reading, unit, health, thresholds, timestamp, valid range and raw member URI.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces grep and unrelated IPMI/GPU output with exhaustive, structured and topology-aware DIMM evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Readable selected responses cannot expose an unmapped installed DIMM, a duplicate zone, stale telemetry or an incorrectly treated empty slot.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Some platforms expose thermal zones rather than per-DIMM values. That can satisfy the case only when the vendor mapping explicitly defines zone membership and acceptance.

project_override_considerations: The Project must define whether telemetry is per-slot or per-zone and how each populated channel maps to it. The later row-1869 duplicate code is GPU-focused and cannot be used as a fallback specification.
expected_evidence: Target/firmware/resource identity and installed DIMM topology
Trusted TLS/auth/client/parser metadata with secrets redacted
Complete Sensors collection and all mapped DIMM member JSON
Population-to-slot/zone mapping with reading, unit, health, thresholds and timestamp
Range/freshness validation and explicit missing/unpopulated distinctions

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and source procedure consistently require Redfish DIMM temperature monitoring. DeepSeek's GPU-named output and IPMI substitution are reference-review defects, not competing Master source objectives.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The vendor URI/schema, memory population and slot/zone mapping are normal package inputs. Execution becomes BLOCKED only if installed DIMMs cannot be unambiguously associated with supported telemetry after the normal request.

review_improvement: Restores the exact Redfish DIMM scope, separates unpopulated from missing coverage and prevents duplicate-code GPU evidence from contaminating this identity.
independent_technical_reasoning: Memory topology and thermal topology are not necessarily one-to-one. A valid audit must first enumerate installed DIMMs, then prove complete coverage through either unique slot sensors or explicitly defined zones. Health, units and timestamp freshness are independent checks; a plausible temperature alone cannot prove correct slot attribution or live telemetry.
